crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
I have sworn by myself. The word has gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and will not be revoked, that to me every…
Who is this who comes from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? Who is this who is glorious in his clothing, marching…
The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”

translations.web: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.
translations.bsb: All the words of my mouth are righteous; none are crooked or perverse.
translations.kjv: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse
translations.asv: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.
